notes.title: Wishlist A Promise Best Left Unkept – Aya Edition, Coming Soon On Early Access!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479300/A_Promise_Best_Left_Unkept__Aya_Edition/

Hey! My next project (Hard NTR) is coming out soon on Early Access! It's an alternative version of my previous project, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2219000/A_Promise_Best_Left_Unkept/]A Promise Best Left Unkept[/url]. Here's a synopsis, for those who don't know about it:

[i]Prompted into action by the promise he made to his girlfriend a year ago, Harry finally made a huge breakthrough in his quest for success by scoring a major deal for his company, in doing so setting into motion his inevitable promotion. But what he didn’t foresee is that the byproduct of his unshakable resolve would unintentionally invite an undesirable presence into his life. The representative of the subcontracting company—his old bully from high school.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919857/166a2fc1c722c4d502910e926c7654b89d396edf.jpg[/img]

A Promise Best Left Unkept – Aya Edition branches out after the event during the business trip and Aya will now be the main heroine of the game. Here are some of the features of the game:
[list]
[*] 300k+ words of new content
[*] Multiple perspective
[*] 40+ CG sets
[*] 30+ Animated sex scenes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40919857/6ef76dfb29094ff9cfdbb8482c02ad5eb36721ef.jpg[/img]

It would mean a lot if you guys could wishlist it!
Here's the link:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2479300/A_Promise_Best_Left_Unkept__Aya_Edition/
